method: Manual neutral-feature and visible-silhouette annotations, draft2. Iris centres are used consistently with owned mesh UV-pole anchors (front ±2 px, occluded quarter far eye ±4 px, profile ±5 px). Front roll is removed using the iris line. Profile has independent weak-perspective scale. Quarter perspective yaw/pitch is pose-only, with explicit lens-distance sensitivity and uncertain tragus correspondence; nose/mouth/chin remain held out.
basis: owned RAW head; no legacy head fit/sculpt/relax
limits: Manual photo annotations and weak-perspective alignment are approximate; the clay views decide likeness. Three-quarter is a held-out visual check, not a fitted score.

held_out_camera.calibration_uncertainty: Only three approximate homologous anchors. Lens distance is not identifiable; pose and held-out errors are diagnostic, not shape ground truth.
